name: Existing app feature upgrade with source isolation and rollback
target: Runs the one-input runAppDeployUpgrade transaction against existing fake app-host and source-world devices; it rejects aliased or nested live-source workspaces, publishes v2 only after isolated changes and passing simulation, and records rollback success or failure after public verification.
inputs: existing app ID, source target, requested change, owner user ID
source snapshot and isolated restored copy
observations: source tree remains unchanged while the isolated copy is modified
successful v2 publication preserves the existing public URL
failed public verification restores v1; failed rollback is returned to the caller and recorded for operator recovery
